title: 第十一章 珍贵的结婴丹道爷现在有一炉子第十二章 妹夫你误会了我只是暮雪的兄长
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 绿竹峰上，竹林成荫，有一竹林小院，名泛海小筑，清风舟御风而下，正落在院外林间。
内门一百零八峰，每一座山峰，都有内门弟子居住，每一弟子住所又各不相同。
如云雁这般金丹后期的真传弟子，所住之处，乃洞天福地中的上品。
灵气浓郁，几乎快凝成了实质，化作灵雾，在绿竹林海之间弥漫。
沙沙——
林风吹动，枝叶作响，秦凡和云蓉刚刚到来，泛海小筑内，便传出轻柔的嗓音来。
“禁制已解，你二人推门进来便是。”
“知道了，姐姐。”
云蓉灿烂一笑，旋即转头对秦凡道：“姐姐人很好，但你别乱说话，免得进去吃苦头。”
“嗯，师弟明白，多谢云蓉师姐提醒。”秦凡点了点头。
吱呀！
推开院门，云蓉和秦凡一同走进泛海小筑，只见院内，栽种了各色奇花异草，芬芳扑鼻，还有一池红鲤，游来游去，好似开了灵智，往旁看去，有位身形婀娜的女子，一袭白裙，盘坐在紫藤架下，吞吐灵雾。
正是真传弟子之一的云雁，也是金丹后期的大修士，在圣地诸多真传弟子之中，也属佼佼。
尤其那一张脸，美的让秦凡忍不住暗自感慨，这修仙，可真是养人啊。
别看云蓉和云雁是堂姐妹关系，可两人差了得有个几十岁。
“姐姐，他就是要见你的那个杂役弟子，他叫秦凡。”云蓉上前，亲昵的挽住了云雁的胳膊。
云雁睁开美眸，一缕青光闪过，秦凡身躯瞬间僵硬，对方神识一扫，他仿佛赤裸站在了眼前。
下意识咽了唾沫，秦凡忍不住胡思乱想起来，这位云雁师姐，不会被自己的兄弟给吓到吧。
毕竟是挺出类拔萃的。
“这位秦师弟，你找我不知是有什么事？”云雁缓缓开口，声音依旧那般轻柔好听。
秦凡收回思绪，恭敬施礼道：“见过云雁师姐，云师姐，师弟此来是想和师姐做个交易。”
“交易？什么交易？”云雁露出些许疑惑，一个小小的杂役弟子，竟敢和她一个金丹大修士做交易？
秦凡道：“我手上有一颗四品结婴丹，只要师姐能帮师弟一个忙，此丹药，师弟当双手奉上。”
云雁目光陡然一凝，四品结婴丹？
云蓉也吓了一跳，四品结婴丹那可是能帮助金丹修士大幅提高化婴概率的灵丹，价值已无法用灵石衡量，是有价无市的宝贝，哪怕真传弟子冲击元婴，圣地也只会赠送一到两颗。
一个是此丹炼制不易，一个是此丹主料培婴果颇为珍贵，其珍贵程度，就连五品六品的一些丹药都比不上。
“秦师弟，这四品结婴丹圣地内都不算多，你是哪里得来的？”云雁紧紧盯着秦凡问道。
秦凡笑道：“此丹是我祖辈传下来的。”
“祖辈？”
云雁心下微动，难不成，这位秦师弟是个有背景的？
略微思索，云雁又问，“那不知师弟要做何交易？”
content_en:
"Huh——"
On the green bamboo peak, shaded by bamboo groves, there is a small bamboo forest courtyard, named Fanhai Xiaozhu. The breeze boat rides down in the wind and lands in the forest outside the courtyard.
There are one hundred and eight peaks in the Inner Sect, and each one is inhabited by Inner Sect disciples, and each disciple's residence is different.
A true disciple of the Jindan late stage like Yun Yan lives in a top-notch place in the Paradise of Cave Heaven.
The aura is so rich that it almost condenses into substance, turning into a spiritual mist that spreads among the green bamboo forest.
rustle——
The forest wind was blowing and the branches and leaves were rustling. Qin Fan and Yun Rong had just arrived when a soft voice came from Fanhai Xiaozhu.
"The restriction has been lifted, just push the door open and come in."
"I know, sister."
Yun Rong smiled brightly, then turned to Qin Fan and said, "Sister is very nice, but don't talk nonsense, lest you go in and suffer."
"Yes, junior brother, I understand. Thank you, senior sister Yun Rong, for reminding me." Qin Fan nodded.
…
Squeak!
Pushing open the courtyard door, Yun Rong and Qin Fan walked into Fanhai Xiaozhu together. They saw various exotic flowers and plants planted in the courtyard, which were fragrant. There was also a pond of red carps swimming around, as if their spiritual wisdom had been awakened. Looking to the side, they saw a graceful woman in a white dress, sitting cross-legged under the wisteria trellis, breathing spiritual mist.
It is Yunyan, one of the true disciples, who is also a great monk in the late Jindan period and is the best among the many true disciples in the Holy Land.
Especially that face, so beautiful that Qin Fan couldn't help but secretly sigh, this cultivator is really nurturing.
Although Yun Rong and Yun Yan are cousins, they are dozens of years apart.
"Sister, he is the handyman disciple who wants to see you. His name is Qin Fan." Yun Rong stepped forward and took Yun Yan's arm affectionately.
Yun Yan opened her beautiful eyes, and a ray of blue light flashed through. Qin Fan's body stiffened instantly. When the other party's consciousness swept away, he seemed to be standing naked in front of him.
Subconsciously swallowing his saliva, Qin Fan couldn't help but think wildly. This senior sister Yunyan wouldn't be scared by her brother.
After all, it is quite outstanding.
"Junior Brother Qin, why are you looking for me?" Yun Yan spoke slowly, his voice still so soft and pleasant.
Qin Fan retracted his thoughts and saluted respectfully: "I have met Senior Sister Yunyan, Senior Sister Yun, and Junior Brother is here to make a deal with Senior Sister."
"Deal? What kind of deal?" Yun Yan showed some doubts. How dare a small handyman disciple make a deal with a golden elixir master like her?
Qin Fan said: "I have a fourth-grade infant-resulting elixir in my hand. As long as senior sister can do a favor for junior brother, junior brother will offer this elixir with both hands."
Yunyan's eyes suddenly condensed, fourth grade Yingying Dan?
Yun Rong was also shocked. The Fourth Grade Infant Formation Pill was a spiritual elixir that could help Golden elixir monks greatly increase the probability of transforming into infants. Its value could no longer be measured by spiritual stones. It was a priceless treasure. Even if the true disciples attacked Yuanying, the Holy Land would only give away one or two pills.
One is that this elixir is not easy to refine, and the other is that the main ingredient of this elixir, Pei Ying Guo, is quite precious. Its preciousness is not comparable to some elixirs of the fifth and sixth grades.
"Junior Brother Qin, there are not many of these fourth-grade Infant Formation Pills in the Holy Land. Where did you get them?" Yun Yan asked, staring at Qin Fan closely.
Qin Fan smiled and said: "This elixir was passed down from my ancestors."
"Ancestors?"
Yun Yan's heart moved slightly. Could it be that this junior brother Qin has a background?
After thinking for a moment, Yun Yan asked again, "What kind of deal does Junior Brother want to make?"
title_en: Chapter 11: The Taoist Master now has a furnace of precious Yingying Dan. Chapter 12: Brother-in-law, you misunderstood that I am just Mu Xue’s brother.
